SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, d.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary d ON cs.molregno = d.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = 1267250
  AND a.standard_type IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_units IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.standard_value ASC;
